layouts.name: Drive Centre Arena
layouts.description: The operator long/short course description and the official STCC 2020 course guide identify the long airfield layout: inner eastern S bends, northern diagonal runway, outer eastern return, southern S connector, runway turnaround and western bulb. Course coordinates come only from licensed Min karta aerial pixels. The public runway paint identifies a physical turnaround. The imagery capture year is unknown. This 4,415.4 m supporting physical-course draft differs from the supplied 4,269 m scalar by 146.4 m and from the operator 4,235 m description by 180.4 m; the discrepancy is retained and historical correspondence and temporary cone positions are unverified. The 200 m import allowance records these discrepancies without moving coordinates or changing timing validators. This is not a certified event lap. Operator plans and video are identification only and are not georeferenced, traced or redistributed. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 4415.4 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
